newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel falls on distressed sales, but arb widens.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel falls on distressed sales, but arb widens.

text.p: NWE cracked fuel oil dropped by $2-3 per tonne towards the end of Monday as some distressed sellers emerged in both high and low sulphur cracked markets, dealers said.
But an open arbitrage to the United States meant the lower prices would be short-lived, they added.
High sulphur cracked barges fell $2/3 to trade at $111.50 and $112 fob ARA and a high sulphur cargo seller loading this week was $3 more aggressive at $114 cif NWE.
A low sulphur cargo loading around Nov 20 in Scandinavia was offered $2 lower at $128 fob.
"There are some distressed sellers because shipping is so tight," a trader said.
But traders kept an opportunistic eye on the rising resid and natural gas prices in the United States, where two Russian cargoes have already been sold for mid-December arrival.
